title: EvolveNet: Collaborative Harness Evolution for Agent Self-Improvement
title_zh: EvolveNet：用于智能体自我改进的协作式 Harness 演化
abstract_en: The capabilities of an LLM agent depend not only on its model but on the harness: the executable program that constructs context, invokes tools, verifies results, and recovers from failure. Recent work shows that evolving the harness yields persistent improvements without updating model weights. Existing approaches, however, assume that all execution experience can be routed to a single optimizer, which evolves one harness along a sequential trajectory. Real agent ecosystems violate that assumption: users, organizations, and environments generate isolated streams of experience that cannot be pooled, so the experience most worth learning from is exactly the experience that cannot be directly centralized. We introduce EvolveNet, a paradigm of collaborative harness evolution that moves experience extraction to the data. A shared harness is broadcast to data-local agent deployments, each of which evolves it on its own workload. Only the resulting program adaptations are composed into an updated shared harness and redistributed, so that every participating agent inherits operational experience discovered by the others. By shifting the aggregation boundary from raw workloads to learned adaptations, EvolveNet keeps workloads local and allows multiple evolutionary searches to proceed concurrently with reduced serial depth. Because independently modified programs cannot be averaged like model parameters and may conflict when composed, EvolveNet introduces scope-typed, evidence-guided program aggregation. Across five settings spanning text-to-SQL, data-science coding, competitive programming, software engineering, and agentic workflows, EvolveNet improves the shared harness in all five, with the largest gains under heterogeneous workloads, and ablations attribute the improvement to composition of adaptations from different agents rather than to selecting among them.
abstract_zh: LLM Agent 的能力不仅取决于底座模型，也取决于 harness：即负责构造上下文、调用工具、验证结果并从失败中恢复的可执行程序。已有研究表明，在不更新模型权重的情况下，演化 harness 可以带来持续性能提升。但现有方法通常假设所有执行经验都能汇聚到单个优化器中，并沿着一条序列轨迹演化同一个 harness；而真实的 Agent 生态中，用户、组织和环境往往产生彼此隔离、无法集中共享的经验流。EvolveNet 提出协作式 harness 演化范式：将共享 harness 分发到各个数据本地的 Agent 部署中，每个部署在自身工作负载上独立演化；随后只聚合得到的程序适配，而非原始数据或执行日志，并将更新后的共享 harness 再分发给所有参与方。这样既保持工作负载本地化，又允许多条演化搜索并行进行，减少串行优化深度。由于独立修改的程序不能像模型参数那样直接平均，且组合时可能冲突，EvolveNet 引入了基于作用域类型和证据引导的程序聚合机制。论文在 text-to-SQL、数据科学代码、竞赛编程、软件工程和 Agentic workflows 五类任务上验证，EvolveNet 在全部设置中都提升了共享 harness，尤其在异构工作负载下收益最大；消融实验表明，性能提升来自不同 Agent 适配的组合，而非简单选择最优适配。
key_points_zh: 提出 EvolveNet，将 harness 演化从集中式单优化器扩展为协作式、多部署并行演化，适配真实场景中数据和经验无法集中共享的问题。
核心思想是“移动经验提取到数据本地”：各本地 Agent 在自身 workload 上演化共享 harness，只上传程序级 adaptations，而不上传原始工作负载或执行经验。
为解决程序适配无法像模型参数一样平均、且可能互相冲突的问题，提出 scope-typed、evidence-guided program aggregation，用于组合不同 Agent 产生的修改。
在 text-to-SQL、data-science coding、competitive programming、software engineering、agentic workflows 五类任务中，EvolveNet 均提升共享 harness 表现，异构工作负载下提升最明显。
消融实验显示，收益主要来自跨 Agent 的 adaptations 组合，而不是在多个候选 harness 中做选择，说明协作聚合本身是关键贡献。

llm_assessment.comment: An excellent fit that directly advances collaborative harness evolution through distributed experience extraction and program-adaptation aggregation.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该论文与领域高度契合，通过分布式经验提取和程序适配聚合直接推进协作式智能体框架演化。
